scheme_name: Satyvadi Raja Harishchandra Marnotar Sahay Yojana
description:
The Satyvadi Raja Harishchandra Marnotar Sahay Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. 

This scheme was launched on 1st January 2021. 

It was introduced to provide financial assistance to the families of deceased individuals who were the primary breadwinners. 

The scheme is named after the legendary king Harishchandra, known for his commitment to truth and justice. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to alleviate the financial burden on families after the loss of their earning member. 

The government aims to provide immediate financial support to help cover funeral expenses. 

Under this scheme, families are entitled to receive a financial assistance amount of ₹10,000. 

This amount is intended to assist with the costs associated with the last rites of the deceased. 

The scheme is particularly beneficial for economically weaker sections of society. 

It targets families who may struggle to afford the expenses related to the death of a family member. 

To be eligible for the benefits of this scheme, applicants must meet certain criteria. 

The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 

The deceased must have been the primary breadwinner of the family. 

There are no specific age limits for the deceased individual. 

The family must belong to the economically weaker sections. 

Income criteria have been set at an annual income of less than ₹2 lakh. 

This income limit is designed to ensure that the benefits reach those who are truly in need. 

The application process for the Satyvadi Raja Harishchandra Marnotar Sahay Yojana is straightforward. 

Interested applicants must visit the local revenue office or the designated government office in their area. 

They need to fill out the application form provided at the office. 

The application form requires details such as the name of the deceased, relationship to the applicant, and income details. 

Applicants must submit a copy of the death certificate of the deceased. 

Additionally, they need to provide proof of residence in Madhya Pradesh. 

Income proof documents such as an income certificate or a copy of the income tax return must also be submitted. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The processing time for applications can vary but is generally completed within 15 days. 

Upon approval, the financial assistance of ₹10,000 will be disbursed to the applicant's bank account. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Revenue, Government of Madhya Pradesh. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the local revenue office. 

They can also reach out to the toll-free number provided by the Madhya Pradesh government for welfare schemes. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to support families during times of crisis. 

It reflects the government’s commitment to social welfare and support for the underprivileged. 

Since its launch, the scheme has aimed to provide timely assistance to numerous families across the state. 

The government has allocated a specific budget for this scheme to ensure its sustainability. 

As of 2023, the scheme continues to operate effectively, providing necessary support to families in distress. 

The initiative has been well-received by the public, with many families benefiting from the financial aid. 

The scheme is part of a larger framework of welfare programs aimed at improving the quality of life for citizens. 

It underscores the importance of social security measures in the face of unforeseen circumstances. 

The Satyvadi Raja Harishchandra Marnotar Sahay Yojana is a testament to the government’s proactive approach to welfare. 

It serves as a model for similar initiatives in other states across India. 

The scheme has been instrumental in reducing the financial stress associated with the death of a family member. 

It provides a safety net for families who may otherwise struggle to afford last rites. 

The government continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme to ensure its effectiveness. 

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the impact of the financial assistance provided. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The scheme is an essential part of Madhya Pradesh's social welfare policies. 

It aligns with the government's vision of inclusive growth and support for the marginalized. 

The Satyvadi Raja Harishchandra Marnotar Sahay Yojana is a significant step towards ensuring dignity in death. 

It acknowledges the cultural importance of last rites in Indian society. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme helps families honor their loved ones appropriately. 

Overall, the scheme is a crucial intervention for the economically weaker sections of Madhya Pradesh. 

It highlights the government's role in providing support during critical life events. 

The Satyvadi Raja Harishchandra Marnotar Sahay Yojana remains a vital resource for families in need. 

It exemplifies the government's commitment to social welfare and community support. 

The scheme continues to evolve based on the needs of the population it serves.
